title: Conveyancing Paralegal

description:

If you are a conveyancing assistant/paralegal looking for a new challenge where you can really advance your career, whilst working on interesting and varied work then this role is worth consideration.

The firm is looking to interview ASAP so if this is of interest please apply using the links or get in touch with Greg at GWR Legal for further details

title: Conveyancing Secretary
description:
We are looking for an experienced Residential Conveyancing Secretary for our client based in Norwich.

Core Responsibilities
- Client Care: Take instructions, explain legal terms, and provide estimates of fees.
- Property Searches: Conduct local authority, environmental, and water searches to identify issues.
- Title Checking: Examine Land Registry documents and title deeds to confirm ownership and boundaries.
- Drafting Contracts: Prepare sales contracts and negotiate terms with the opposing side's solicitor.
- Financial Handling: Manage deposits, mortgage funds, and calculate Stamp Duty.
- Exchange and Completion: Exchange contracts, transfer funds, and register the new ownership with the Land Registry.

Key Skills and Qualifications
- Qualifications: Often a qualified Solicitor, Licensed Conveyancer, or Legal Executive.
- Attention to Detail: Ability to spot legal risks in complex property titles and searches.
- Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to liaise with clients, estate agents, and mortgage lenders.
- Time Management: Capable of handling a heavy caseload under tight deadlines.
- IT Proficiency: Experience using computerized case management systems and the Land Registry portal.

Please apply with your updated CV.

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Criminal Legal Secretary

Kings Lynn, Norfolk

Competitive Salary Full-Time Permanent

A well-established and respected law firm in Kings Lynn is seeking an experienced Criminal Legal Secretary to join its busy and supportive team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive and organised legal secretary who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in providing exceptional administrative support.

The Role

Working closely with solicitors and fee earners, you will be responsible for:
- Audio and copy typing of legal documents and correspondence
- Managing client communications and enquiries
- Liaising with courts, barristers, police stations and external parties
- Diary management and arranging appointments
- Preparing legal documents and court bundles
- Opening and closing client files
- Maintaining accurate records and case management systems
- General secretarial and administrative support to the Criminal Law department

About You

The successful candidate will ideally have:
- Previous experience as a Legal Secretary, ideally within Criminal Law
- Excellent audio typing and document production skills
- Strong organisational and time management abilities
- High attention to detail and accuracy
- A professional and confidential approach to work
- Excellent communication and client care skills
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and case management systems

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary dependent on experience
- Supportive and friendly working environment
- Opportunity to work for a reputable local law firm
- Long-term career prospects and development opportunities
- Generous holiday entitlement and additional staff benefits

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a highly regarded legal practice where your contribution will be valued and where you can continue to develop your legal secretarial career within criminal law.

To apply or find out more, please contact Michelle Topley at Reed Legal on or email your CV to

title: Wills & Probate Paralegal
description:
Are you experienced in Wills & Probate and looking to continue your career, ideally in a firm that will be offering a training contract?

This role sits within the Private client team which delivers a full range of legal services including drafting of wills and lasting powers of attorney, document preparation, probate and estate administration and search and analysis.

As a private client paralegal, you will be responsible for:
- Assisting the private client lawyers with probate and estate administration
- Draft correspondence and documents ensuing they are accurate and meet our customer's requirements
- Using case management systems to generate and complete correspondence and documents
- Coordinating and attend meetings, take instructions and notes and liaise with customers
- Researching laws and regulations
- Liaising with other professionals such as financial advisor's and accountants
- Assisting the team with their case-load as appropriate
- Review client documents
- Assist with ensuring client billing is undertaken accurately and within deadlines
- Ensuring compliance responsibilities and adhered to

This firm is invested in each employee's career progression especially for paralegal's, as their goal is to progress and retain the best legal professionals.

We look forward to your application.
